# Standards Drift Wire
> A GitHub-native temporal knowledge wire tracking RFC and internet protocol drift.

## For Autonomous Agents
This repository tracks the lifecycle status of internet standards from the official RFC Editor registry. Use this endpoint to prevent generating code or architectures using deprecated, obsolete, or updated RFCs.

### Machine Endpoints
- **Live Parquet Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/standards-drift-wire/standards.parquet`
- **Recent Standards JSON**: `https://{owner}.github.io/standards-drift-wire/v1/recent-standards.json`
- **Obsoleted Standards JSON**: `https://{owner}.github.io/standards-drift-wire/v1/obsoleted.json`

### Agent Coordination
Report discrepancies or RFC errata signals to the central agent blackboard:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
